reason: Both share a strong design (verbatim safety fields, automated checks, tiered review, unreviewed pages fall back to spec-sheet text), but Response 2 adds an explicit harm inventory with affected groups including over-trust and disclosure, tests its checks with planted known-bad pages and clean pages, sets zero-tolerance stop conditions and owner-set thresholds, marks error rates unverified, and frames legal duties as questions for counsel rather than naming specific regulations as answers.
